items.title: Personal agents are the ultimate manifestation of “build something that agents want”
items.text: Personal agents are the ultimate manifestation of “build something that agents want”. The form factor of a product like Muse is you want to be able to hand off a task to the agent and ensure that it is fully completed end to end. To do this, the agent must be able to successfully operate with your tools or use its own to complete the task. Use your MCP or CLI, easily navigate your site, be able to transact, and more. The new attention you need to compete for is not from the user itself but instead for the agent.
